 Tennis player Joint defeats world No. 16 in Tokyo — ABC News Australia 
 Fedir Kryshtovskyi
 27
 October
 2026
 23:14
-->
 Australian tennis player Maya Joint defeated Romanian Sorana Cirstea in a Pan Pacific Open match in Tokyo, Japan, and advanced to the tournament's round of 16. Joint beat the sixth seed 6:3, 7:6 (7:4), ABC News reports .
 Victory over a favourite
 Before the start of the WTA 500 tournament, Joint was ranked 94th in the world — 78 places below Cirstea, who is world No. 16. In February, the Australian rose to a career-high 28th position, but her ranking declined during the year.
 The victory in Tokyo continued a successful period for Joint. Last month, she reached the Korea Open final in Seoul, where she lost to compatriot Kim Birrell 4:6, 2:6. The title was Birrell's first at WTA level.
 More current news is available on the UA.News Telegram channel Telegram .
 Next matches
 In the round of 16, Joint will play Spain's Cristina Bucsa, the world No. 42. In the previous match, Bucsa defeated France's Diane Parry 7:5, 6:1.
 Another Australian, Talia Gibson, who recently reached the final of a tournament in Singapore, defeated qualifier Daria Kasatkina 6:0, 7:5. Gibson won the first eight games in a row, but Kasatkina made her work in the second set. In the next round, the Australian will face eighth seed Alexandra Eala of the Philippines.
 At the tournament in Guangzhou, American Venus Williams lost to Austrian tennis player Lilli Tagger 2:6, 2:6. For the 46-year-old Williams, it was her 13th singles defeat this year. The 28-year age gap between Williams and 18-year-old Tagger may be a record for a WTA Tour match, the source notes.
